name: Tenbin Brazilian Real
oneLiner: tBRL is Tenbin's synthetic Brazilian real token on Ethereum, backed by USDC reserves hedged with CME BRL futures under KYC-gated USDC mint and redemption.
collateral: Synthetic Brazilian real exposure, not Brazilian real bank deposits: each token represents an unsecured Tenbin AssetCo (BVI) SPC Ltd. segregated-portfolio debt-note (a UCC Article 12 controllable electronic record) referencing the USD value of one Brazilian real at the spot price. Backed by Circle USDC held on-chain in a Steakhouse USDC Morpho V2 vault (355,144.70 USDC at Ethereum block 26505955) and off-chain at prime broker Ripple Prime and FCM accounts margining CME Brazilian real futures hedges.
pegMechanism: KYC-gated mint and redemption through the immutable Ethereum Controller contract using EIP-712 orders signed by approved participants and cosigned by a Tenbin backend HSM minter key in standard (backend-executed) or cosigned (user-executed) modes. Redemptions burn tBRL and settle atomically on-chain in USDC once Tenbin's backend approves and cosigns the order (approval timing is discretionary and unbounded on-chain) at the BRL/USD reference value rather than fiat reals, subject to a Chainlink BRL/USD 8% backstop tolerance, a 50,000,000 tBRL per-block limit, and pass-through execution costs plus a conditional market adjustment fee.

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: Pharos Listing Policy v2 PR-2 addition review
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Tenbin primary documentation and binding Terms of Use specify that tBRL is a USDC-collateralized synthetic FX debt-note whose Brazilian real price exposure is hedged off-chain with delta-one CME futures via regulated FCM counterparties and prime broker Ripple Prime, with on-chain USDC held in a Morpho V2 vault. The peg relies on a centrally operated delta-neutral hedging program rather than Brazilian real bank cash or sovereign bills, matching synthetic-delta-neutral.

notices.title: Synthetic BRL debt-note, aggregate PoR only, and thin DEX liquidity
notices.message: tBRL is an unsecured Tenbin AssetCo (BVI) SPC debt-note backed by USDC and hedged with CME BRL futures, redeemable only in USDC under KYC rather than fiat Brazilian reals. No asset-specific independent reserve attestation is published; Tenbin's Base Chainlink Proof of Reserve feed reports one combined off-chain reserve figure across all Tenbin assets. Public on-chain AMM liquidity is minimal, with near-zero DEX trading volume.
